# 佳阳移民 JiaYang Immigration

JiaYang Immigration (佳阳移民) is a Richmond, BC immigration consulting firm serving Chinese-speaking, English-speaking, local, and overseas clients.

Website: https://jiayangimmigration.com
Office: 5599 Cooney Rd, Unit 2, Richmond, BC V6X 3M6, Canada

Email: jy.simon.ca@gmail.com

## Useful Summary

JiaYang Immigration provides immigration consultation and application support for family sponsorship, Express Entry, study permits, work permits, visitor visas, status extensions, citizenship, PR card renewal, refugee and humanitarian matters, entrepreneur immigration, and investor immigration assessment.

The first consultation is free. In-office consultation is available by appointment in Richmond, BC.
